context-map.description: See how system prompts, files, conversations, and tool results fill an agent’s context window.
context-map.comparisonBody: Switch snapshots to see the tokens kept, summarized, or dropped. Hover or focus a tile for details, click to pin it, and press Escape to clear it.
context-map.blocksProp: Ordered token sources with id, label, kind, tokens, and optional detail, icon, and items. Use unique, stable IDs across snapshots.
context-map.limitProp: Positive context capacity in tokens. Unused capacity appears as the dashed tile.
context-map.modelProp: Optional active model name and decorative model icon.
context-map.agentsProp: Agents have id, label, limit, and optional model and modelIcon. Each agent supplies the capacity. Update blocks and compaction when the active agent changes.
context-map.compactionProp: Provide before, summarized and dropped ID arrays, and the replacement summary ID. Pass null to show the pending message.
context-map.viewProp: Controls the displayed snapshot when supplied. The component also manages this choice locally.
context-map.statusProp: Optional status in the header, such as Compacting.
context-map.selectProp: Called when a tile is activated. The free-space tile passes null.
context-map.labelsProp: Override the title or copy, format numbers for a locale, and customize the outer layout.
